title: Seed a variable color spectrum and structural scale for compact components
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Background: Our current token set has grown organically and contains duplicated semantic and raw color values which cause inconsistent rendering across compact components (buttons, table rows, data cards, and chart overlays). This ticket establishes a repeatable, variable-first spectrum and a small-form structural scale (spacing, border-radius, elevation) that resolves contrast drift in dense layouts and provides safe defaults for compact UI. Goals: 1) Define a variable color ramp with semantic anchors (surface, interactive, accent, neutral) that maps to WCAG AA contrast targets for small text and icons; 2) Create a compact spacing/radius rhythm (fractions allowed: 2, 4, 6, 8, 10) that aligns with touch and visual density needs; 3) Introduce layered elevation tokens for data overlays and charts to preserve legibility; 4) Provide a codemod + migration plan so consumers can opt-in and opt-out during rollout. Scope: token definitions, updated Figma palette and component token tokens, codemod script, Storybook visual tests, and release notes. Out of scope: full re-skin of all legacy apps (will be follow-up remediation).
acceptance_criteria: New variable token file committed (tokens/variables/compact-spectrum.json) and exported in the design token pipeline
Figma palette updated with annotated usage guidance for each semantic anchor and contrast examples for 12px/14px/16px text
Component library has a feature-flagged CSS token alias layer so components opt into the compact scale without API-breaking props
Automated codemod exists to replace prioritized legacy tokens with the new semantic aliases and passes CI on core repos
Visual diff regression suite shows no >3% visual change for canary set (buttons, dense table rows, charts) when migrating to new tokens
Migration doc and release notes published with step-by-step rollback instructions
token_changes: old: color-surface-100 -> new: surface.neutral-0 (variable) with delta +/- 5 for light/dark mode
old: accent-500 -> new: interactive.primary (semantic anchor; recommends tint +10 for hover)
old: text-muted-400 -> new: content.dim (semantic alias; ensured AA at 12px on surface.neutral-0)
old: radius-small -> new: layout.radius.compact (2px) and layout.radius.condensed (4px) for slightly larger controls
old: spacing-2 -> new: layout.gap.1 (2px); spacing-8 -> layout.gap.4 (8px); new fractional step: layout.gap.2-5 (6px,10px) included
old: elevation-xs -> new: elevation.layer.surface (two-layer token approach: elevation.layer.surface + elevation.shadow.soft)

migration_plan: Phase 1 (canary): Publish tokens behind feature flag; update internal Console components to opt-in; run visual diff on core pages
Phase 2 (codemod): Release automated codemod and migration guide; coordinate with two consumer teams for scheduled migration windows
Phase 3 (wide rollout): Flip flag by default for new component library minor release; publish deprecation timeline for legacy tokens
Rollback: Provide script to remap semantic aliases back to legacy tokens and pin component version
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Contrast regressions in deeply-nested components. Mitigation: Add contrast unit tests and require WCAG checks during CI for any token change.
Risk: Runtime theme flicker when switching token sets. Mitigation: Use CSS custom property fallback and client-side prefetching to avoid reflow.
Risk: Consumer resistance due to breaking spacing in dense layouts. Mitigation: Provide opt-in aliases and automated visual-diff report per repo to show delta before merge.
